items.title: Pro-Russian Hackers Claim Cyberattack on French Postal Service

items.title: Attacks are Evolving: 3 Ways to Protect Your Business in 2026
items.description: Every year, cybercriminals find new ways to steal money and data from businesses. Breaching a business network, extracting sensitive data, and selling it on the dark web has become a reliable payday. But in 2025, the data breaches that affected small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) challenged our perceived wisdom about exactly which types of businesses cybercriminals are targeting.
